info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Parking Reservations Permits-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations API provides businesses and developers with the ability to retrieve detailed information about parking reservation permits. This endpoint facilitates quick access to existing permits, enabling users to view availability and manage reservations effectively. Typical consumers of this API include parking service providers, event organizers, and municipalities looking to streamline their parking management processes. By integrating this API, users can enhance their operational efficiency and improve the overall customer experience when managing parking resources.

get.summary: Retrieve a permit for a reservation.
get.description: This operation allows you to fetch the permit details associated with a specific reservation. It ensures you have the necessary permissions and information before proceeding with the reservation process.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving reservation permits. This body must include the necessary parameters in JSON format to specify the details of the reservations for which permits are requested.
